name: with-table-rows
description: New STATE in which the table NAME holds ROWS (the table is added if absent)
definition:
(defun with-table-rows (state name rows)
  "New STATE in which the table NAME holds ROWS; the table is added if absent."
  (if (assoc name state :test #'string=)
      (mapcar (lambda (table)
                (if (string= (first table) name) (list name rows) table))
              state)
      (append state (list (list name rows)))))

  "The strings in STRINGS joined with SEPARATOR between each pair; \"\" for none."

name: fmt-integer
description: Formats a non-negative integer with commas as thousands separators
definition:
(defun fmt-integer (n)
  "Formats a non-negative integer with commas as thousands separators"
  (let ((s (format nil "~a" n)))
    (if (<= (length s) 3)
        s
        (let ((rest (fmt-integer (floor n 1000)))
              (last3 (format nil "~3,'0d" (mod n 1000))))
          (format nil "~a,~a" rest last3)))))

name: fmt-decimal
description: Formats a non-negative number to two decimal places with commas in the integer part
definition:
(defun fmt-decimal (n)
  "Formats a non-negative number to two decimal places with commas in the integer part"
  (let* ((int-part (floor n))
         (frac-part (mod n 1))
         (int-str (fmt-integer int-part))
         (frac-str (format nil "~2,'0d" (round (* frac-part 100)))))
    (concatenate 'string int-str "." frac-str)))

(defun amortization-schedule (principal rate years)
  "Compute the mortgage amortization schedule rows for a given principal, rate, and term" (let* ((n (* years 12)) (r (/ rate 1200.0)) (payment (if (zerop r) (/ (float principal) (float n)) (* (float principal) r (/ 1.0 (- 1.0 (expt (1+ r) (- n))))))) (rows nil) (balance (float principal)) (month 0)) (loop (incf month) (let* ((interest (* balance r)) (principal-paid (- payment interest)) (new-balance (- balance principal-paid))) (push (list month (format nil "~,2f" payment) (format nil "~,2f" interest) (format nil "~,2f" principal-paid) (format nil "~,2f" new-balance)) rows) (setf balance new-balance) (when (= month n) (return (nreverse rows)))))))

name: monthly-payment
description: Computes the monthly mortgage payment for a given principal, annual rate, and term in years.
definition:
(defun monthly-payment (principal rate years)
  "Computes the monthly mortgage payment for a given principal, annual rate, and term in years."
  (let* ((months (* years 12))
         (r (monthly-rate rate)))
    (if (zerop r)
        (/ (float principal) months)
        (* (float principal) r (/ 1.0 (- 1.0 (expt (+ 1.0 r) (- months))))))))

name: days-in-month
description: Returns the number of days in a given month of a year
definition:
(defun days-in-month (year month)
  "Returns the number of days in a given month of a year"
  (let* ((leap (and (zerop (mod year 4))
                    (or (not (zerop (mod year 100)))
                        (zerop (mod year 400)))))
         (days (case month
                 (1 31) (3 31) (5 31) (7 31) (8 31) (10 31) (12 31)
                 (4 30) (6 30) (9 30) (11 30)
                 (2 (if leap 29 28))
                 (t 0))))
    days))

name: fmt-date
description: Formats a Unix timestamp as a YYYY-MM-DD string
definition:
(defun fmt-date (now)
  "Formats a Unix timestamp as a YYYY-MM-DD string"
  (let* ((days (floor now 86400))
         (year 1970)
         (day-of-year 0)
         (leap-p (lambda (y) (or (and (zerop (mod y 4)) (not (zerop (mod y 100)))) (zerop (mod y 400)))))
         (days-in-year (lambda (y) (if (funcall leap-p y) 366 365)))
         (remaining days))
    (loop while (>= remaining (funcall days-in-year year))
          do (decf remaining (funcall days-in-year year))
             (incf year))
    (setf day-of-year remaining)
    (let ((month 1)
          (day 1)
          (month-days (lambda (m y) (case m
                                      (1 31) (2 (if (funcall leap-p y) 29 28))
                                      (3 31) (4 30) (5 31) (6 30)
                                      (7 31) (8 31) (9 30) (10 31)
                                      (11 30) (12 31)))))
      (loop while (>= day-of-year (funcall month-days month year))
            do (decf day-of-year (funcall month-days month year))
               (incf month))
      (setf day (1+ day-of-year))
      (format nil "~4d-~2,'0d-~2,'0d" year month day))))

name: cmd-calc-fancy
description: Calculates mortgage with fancy formatting
definition:
(defun cmd-calc-fancy (args state now)
  "Calculates mortgage with fancy formatting"
  (declare (ignore state now))
  (let ((principal (parse-number (first args)))
        (rate (parse-number (second args)))
        (years (parse-number (third args))))
    (if (or (null principal) (null rate) (null years))
        (list :error "Invalid input" :state state)
        (let* ((months (* years 12))
               (payment (monthly-payment principal rate years))
               (totals (mortgage-totals principal payment months))
               (total-interest (first totals))
               (total-cost (second totals)))
          (list :output (format nil "Payment: ~a~%Total Interest: ~a~%Total Cost: ~a" (fmt-money payment) (fmt-money total-interest) (fmt-money total-cost)) :state state)))))

name: number-from-string
description: The number written in TEXT, such as "42", "-3" or "6.5"; NIL when TEXT is not a number
definition:
(defun number-from-string (text)
  "The number written in TEXT, such as \"42\", \"-3\" or \"6.5\"; NIL when TEXT is not a number."
  (if (numberp text)
      text
      (let* ((s (string-trim " " (if (stringp text) text "")))
             (neg (and (> (length s) 0) (char= (char s 0) #\-)))
             (body (if (and (> (length s) 0) (find (char s 0) "+-")) (subseq s 1) s))
             (dot (position #\. body))
             (whole (if dot (subseq body 0 dot) body))
             (frac (if dot (subseq body (1+ dot)) "")))
        (if (and (> (+ (length whole) (length frac)) 0)
                 (every (function digit-char-p) whole)
                 (every (function digit-char-p) frac))
            (let ((value (+ (if (string= whole "") 0 (parse-integer whole))
                            (if (string= frac "") 0
                                (/ (parse-integer frac) (expt 10 (length frac)))))))
              (if dot
                  (float (if neg (- value) value) 1.0d0)
                  (if neg (- value) value)))
            nil))))

name: sim-compute
description: Computes mortgage payment, totals, and milestones for a given principal, rate, and years
definition:
(defun sim-compute (principal rate years)
  "Computes mortgage payment, totals, and milestones for a given principal, rate, and years"
  (let* ((payment (monthly-payment principal rate years))
         (months (* years 12))
         (totals (mortgage-totals principal payment months))
         (total-interest (first totals))
         (total-cost (second totals))
         (schedule (amortization-schedule principal rate years))
         (milestones (sim-milestones schedule)))
    (list payment total-interest total-cost milestones)))

(defun compare-table (id1 id2 rec1 rec2)

(let* ((f1 (loan-numeric-fields rec1)) (f2 (loan-numeric-fields rec2)) (p1 (second f1)) (r1 (third f1)) (y1 (fourth f1)) (p2 (second f2)) (r2 (third f2)) (y2 (fourth f2)) (mp1 (monthly-payment p1 r1 y1)) (mp2 (monthly-payment p2 r2 y2)) (m1 (* mp1 (* y1 12))) (m2 (* mp2 (* y2 12))) (t1 (mortgage-totals p1 mp1 m1)) (t2 (mortgage-totals p2 mp2 m2)) (rows (list (compare-row "Principal" p1 p2) (compare-row "Rate" r1 r2) (compare-row "Term" y1 y2) (compare-row "Monthly Payment" mp1 mp2) (compare-row "Total Interest" (first t1) (first t2)) (compare-row "Total Cost" (second t1) (second t2))))) (format nil "~{~a~^~%~}" rows)))

name: sim-lookup
description: Find a loan record by id string in the state tables

(defun sim-lookup (state id)
  "Find a loan record by id string in the state tables"
  (let ((rows (table-rows state "loans")))
    (let ((row (find id rows :test #'string= :key #'car)))
      (if row
          (values row nil)

name: amortize-parse-row
description: Parse a loan row into (principal rate years) as floats
definition:
(defun amortize-parse-row (row)
  "Parse a loan row into (principal rate years) as floats"
  (let* ((principal (float (parse-number (second row))))
         (rate-str (third row))
         (dot-pos (position #\. rate-str))
         (rate (if dot-pos
                   (+ (parse-number (subseq rate-str 0 dot-pos))
                      (/ (parse-number (subseq rate-str (1+ dot-pos)))
                         (expt 10 (length (subseq rate-str (1+ dot-pos))))))
                   (parse-number rate-str)))
         (years (float (parse-number (fourth row)))))
    (list principal (float rate) years)))

name: calc-compute
description: Compute mortgage summary plist
definition:
(defun calc-compute (principal rate years)
  "Compute mortgage summary plist"
  (let* ((p (monthly-payment principal rate years))
         (months (round (* years 12.0)))
         (totals (mortgage-totals principal p months))
         (ti (first totals))
         (tc (second totals))
         (schedule (amortization-schedule principal rate years))
         (ms (sim-milestones schedule)))
    (list :payment p :total-interest ti :total-cost tc :milestones ms)))

description: Simulate a loan with 3-column layout, returning usage if args are missing
definition:
(defun cmd-simulate (args state now)
  "Simulate a loan with 3-column layout, returning usage if args are missing"
  (if (null args)
      '(:output "Usage: simulate <id>")
      (let ((id (first args)))
        (let ((row (sim-lookup state id)))
          (if (null row)
              '(:output "Loan not found")
              (let ((principal (first row))
                    (rate (second row))
                    (years (third row)))
                (let ((result (sim-compute principal rate years)))
                  (let ((principal (first result))
                        (rate (second result))
                        (years (third result))
                        (payment (fourth result))
                        (total-interest (fifth result))
                        (total-cost (sixth result))
                        (milestones (seventh result)))
                    (let ((output (sim-format principal rate years payment total-interest total-cost milestones)))
                      '(:output output))))))))))

(defun handle-command (args state now)
  "Dispatches a command list to the matching cmd-<word> tool, returning a plist with :output." (let ((word (if (consp args) (string-downcase (first args)) ""))) (cond ((string= word "help") (list :output "Usage: help, clear, calc, save, list, export, amortize, report")) ((string= word "clear") (cmd-clear args state now)) ((string= word "calc") (cmd-calc args state now)) ((string= word "save") (cmd-save args state now)) ((string= word "list") (cmd-list args state now)) ((string= word "export") (cmd-export args state now)) ((string= word "amortize") (cmd-amortize args state now)) ((string= word "report") (cmd-report args state now)) (t (list :output "Usage: help, clear, calc, save, list, export, amortize, report")))))

name: cmd-save
description: Saves a loan row to the state
definition:
(defun cmd-save (args state now)
  "Saves a loan row to the state"
  (let* ((principal (first args))
         (rate (second args))
         (years (third args))
         (row (list principal rate years))
         (loans (or (assoc "loans" state :test #'string=) (list "loans" ())))
         (rows (second loans))
         (new-rows (append rows (list row)))
         (new-loans (list "loans" new-rows))
         (new-state (append (remove-if (lambda (tbl) (string= (first tbl) "loans")) state) (list new-loans)))
         (id (length new-rows)))
    (list :output (format nil "Saved loan ~a" id) :state new-state)))

name: clear-loans-table
description: Returns a new state list with the 'loans' table rows set to NIL, preserving order and other tables.
definition:
(defun clear-loans-table (state)
  "Returns a new state list with the 'loans' table rows set to NIL, preserving order and other tables."
  (mapcar (lambda (table)
            (let ((name (first table))
                  (rows (second table)))
              (if (string-equal name "loans")
                  (list name nil)
                  table)))
          state))
